listing.description_html:
80 fun mazes that turn screen time into brain time!

This maze book starts super easy so kids ages 4 to 8 feel confident, then gets a little harder on every page. Thick, clear paths make it easy to trace with a pencil or crayon, and every maze has a big START and FINISH.

  • 80 mazes from easy to hard
  • Solutions included at the back
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages
  • Builds focus, patience and problem solving
  • Perfect for road trips, restaurants, quiet time and classrooms

A smart gift that keeps kids busy for hours. Add it to your cart today!
